parameters.name: ignoreJobSummary
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude job summary information, such as jobName and status, from the response. If set to true, the response includes only the JobId. This improves performance.

parameters.name: ignoreResourceSetting
parameters.description: Specifies whether to exclude resource configuration information, such as parallelism and the number of CUs, from the response. This reduces the size of the returned data.

parameters.name: labelKey
parameters.description: The label key used for filtering.

parameters.name: labelValue
parameters.description: The label value. You can specify multiple values separated by commas (,) to create an OR condition.
